title: Reject empty, malformed, or placeholder planning documents
goal: Stop product and architecture gates from approving untouched templates or requirement tables with no valid contract rows.
in_scope: Fail product-tier validation when the PRD contains no valid requirement rows
Detect and reject malformed REQ-like rows instead of silently discarding them
Detect known template placeholder markers across architecture-tier documents and ADRs
Cover the current system overview, tech stack, data model, API design, infrastructure, and ADR scaffold files
Require a substantive threat model in the system overview or a dedicated security-threat-model.md, with Architect and Security persona evidence
out_of_scope: Writing the missing architecture or security design itself
acceptance: check-docs.mjs rejects a PRD with zero valid requirement rows or malformed REQ-like rows, and an explicit architecture-tier check rejects template placeholder content in the system, stack, data, API, infrastructure, and ADR documents and requires a substantive security threat model so draft scaffolds cannot satisfy G4 validation.
invariants: Tier-scoped checks report only the selected tier plus required cross-reference parsing
A syntactically valid front-matter status cannot mask placeholder body content
Filled, internally consistent product and architecture fixtures continue to pass
